gap: No result ChatGPT got states that 3,000 W at 120 V is 25 A, more than a 20 A household socket (2,400 W) can carry, so ChatGPT's pick (EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max Plus) and the DJI Power 2000, which have no 30 A TT-30R outlet, can only deliver their 3,000 W split across two or more sockets, and the DJI passes just 12 A (1,440 W) while plugged into the wall.
standout_why: Compared against rvgearlab (cited), powerstationsrated (cited), wattsift (cited), truewattlab (cited), powerstations.reviews/jackery-3000 (cited) and outagehouse (in results, not cited). The five cited pages give no per-socket limit and no grid-on limit. rvgearlab only says which Dabbsson and AFERIY models list a TT-30; wattsift only warns not to assume a TT-30. outagehouse already has the mechanism (2,400 W per household outlet, 3,600 W from the 30 A outlet, pass-through capped at 1,440 to 1,800 W), but for the Apex 300, Jackery HomePower 3000 / 3600 Plus, F3800 Plus and DELTA Pro 3, not for the DELTA 3 Max Plus, DJI Power 2000, Anker F3000 or Apex 200. ChatGPT's second answer already said the EcoFlow's outlets are 20 A each, so the EcoFlow half is partly known; the missing TT-30R on the two 2 kWh picks and DJI's 12 A bypass figure are new.
decides: It splits the 3,000 W line by plan. For two appliances on two sockets (heater plus microwave), the 2,048 Wh units without a TT-30R work, and the EcoFlow or DJI can stay the pick on price and weight. For anything that needs more than 2,400 W down one cord (a 30 A RV shore cord, an inlet box), the pick has to be a unit with a TT-30R: Anker F3000 (3,600 W from the TT-30R per Anker, but sold out today with a 3 to 7 week ship notice), Jackery HomePower 3000 (per outagehouse), or ours with a TT-30R on the records supplied (BLUETTI Apex 200, ALLPOWERS R3500, Growatt HELIOS 3600, Mango Power E). I could not re-read the TT-30R watt ratings for ours today. The Apex 200 ships from mid-February 2027, so under the four-week rule it cannot be the pick. Also: none of these runs a 3,000 W load as a plugged-in UPS from a 15 A wall outlet; DJI states 12 A in bypass.
